resources.string: Sigil lets you control your phone with hand gestures seen by the front camera and with your voice. It needs this service to know which app is open, to tap, scroll and type where you point, and to run the voice requests you make. Sigil only acts when you make a gesture or a request, shows every step on screen and always asks before sending or posting anything. Camera frames, audio and screen content are processed on your phone and are not stored or sent anywhere.
Shown while Sigil uses the camera to follow your hand.
The front camera is on for gesture control.
The front camera and the microphone are on for gestures and voice.
Start or stop hands free control and see whether Sigil is on.
Paused. The camera is off until you resume.
Too dark for the camera. Gestures wait for more light.
The camera is busy or unavailable. Sigil tries again by itself.
The phone is hot. Tracking runs slower.
